item.title: Box full of rubbish, 4th November
item.description:
I am writing to urgently report a severely misused yellow council grit bin located on the pavement directly outside the entrance of Herbert Morrison PS. As shown in the attached photo ("image.png"), the bin has been vandalised with graffiti. More concerningly, it is currently full of rubbish and is being used as a dumping ground rather than for winter salt. Given its location right outside a school, this overflowing rubbish poses a hygiene and safety hazard for the children, and the graffiti is an eyesore for the neighborhood. Please can the council arrange for the rubbish to be cleared and the graffiti removed as soon as possible? If this bin is no longer actively maintained for winter road grit, I request that it be removed entirely to prevent further fly-tipping. Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Hartington Road, Vauxhall, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
